name: CoA Legendary Items: item stream
contract: LevelScaling=1, offset=3, CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. World entry streams SMSG_PATCH_ITEM rows only for items
the character holds, not the whole legendary table. Single and bulk item queries add the queried rows once
each: all 64 designs have matching eight-field rows, with no ninth field, and so do the boundary level
variants. Native bulk item queries supply correct names, legendary quality, slots, custom class masks and
required/item levels. Captured socketless session packets do not establish network delivery or client
Observe the single-query compatibility hook, then dispatch its ordinary core handler separately. Require
one actual item response before repeating both entries in a bulk request, two responses for each after it,
and no duplicate display patch. Text presence remains a separate boolean assertion.

steps.label: Dispatch the original single-item query through its ordinary core handler
